theorem: For every exact self-adjoint refinement A_tilde=R A R* direct-sum B and its normalized linear isometry R, the mean-zero affine carrier maps into the refined mean-zero carrier and g_Atilde(Ru,Rv)=g_A(u,v). Constant vector fields have zero covariant derivative for both flat Levi-Civita connections, hence R(nabla_u v)=nabla_tilde_Ru(Rv). Translation invariance, metric compatibility, and zero torsion uniquely determine this flat connection on each affine carrier. Therefore the ST253 connection is natural under the entire exact linear-isometric refinement category, including arbitrary positive complement B.
